documents.title: Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Commencement Of Commercial Production And Supply - ASK GTD Control Cable Private Limited, Joint Venture Of The Company

analysis.summary: ASK Automotive Limited reported strong performance in Q1 FY27, achieving its highest ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, with consolidated revenue growing by 52.1%. Management expressed optimism regarding the medium-term industry outlook and revised the full-year revenue growth guidance to high teens. The company also detailed ongoing capacity expansions, including a new plant in the South, and discussed captive solar plant commissioning timelines and margin dynamics affected by aluminium price pass-throughs. ASK Automotive reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, achieving highest-ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT with consolidated revenue growth up 52.1% YoY. Management highlighted that absolute EBITDA grew by 32.7% YoY supported by volume-driven economies of scale, increasing capacity utilisation at Karoli and the new Bangalore facility, and the strategic closure of the low-margin wheel assembly business.

guidance.claim: Management revised the full-year revenue growth guidance to high teens.
guidance.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

guidance.claim: Management expects exports to increase by 20% in the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: Last year, we could not go near the target anywhere, but this time, we have given a guidance of 20% increase in the exports, and at the moment, we are still very confident we'll achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of growing around mid-teens in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

guidance.claim: Alloy wheel revenue is expected to be around Rs. 90 to Rs. 100 Cr in FY27.
guidance.quote: FY27 we are expecting revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr and FY28 will be about Rs. 220 Cr.

guidance.claim: The company targets a 20% growth in exports provided the geopolitical situation remains reasonable.
guidance.quote: This year we are very confident of growing at 20%, provided the geopolitical situation remains reasonable, which we are as an optimist, which we feel that it shall be sorted out soon rather than later.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand remains robust and private consumption is resilient.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic demand remains robust, private consumption is resilient, and the Government of India's structural reforms, particularly GST 2.0, continue to energize the broader economy and, importantly for us the automobile sector, given its deep forward and backward linkages.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian automobile sector carried strong momentum into the first quarter of FY27 with overall vehicle production growing by 22.1%.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian automobile sector has carried strong momentum into the first quarter of FY27. Overall vehicle production across all segments registered a robust year-on-year growth of 22.1% in Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The two-wheeler segment recorded production growth of 22.8% on a year-on-year basis in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler segment, which is most relevant to us, recorded production growth of 22.8% on a year-on-year basis, with total two-wheeler production of 72.5 lakh units in Q1 FY27, up from 59.50 lakh units in the same quarter last year.

demand_outlook.claim: OEM customers are carrying on with their original production schedules showing nice growth.
demand_outlook.quote: As far outlook of the two-wheeler industry is concerned, our all our OEM customers they are carrying on with their original production schedules which shows a nice growth in this year also and none of the supplies have been affected by the raw materials or anything.

demand_outlook.claim: The independent aftermarket business grew by 24.7% in FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Happy to share that our independent aftermarket has grown by 24.7% in FY26.

demand_outlook.claim: Production orders from customers are robust with no disruptions faced.
demand_outlook.quote: No, we have not faced any disruption in the production side. Even the even the orders from the customers are also robust.

demand_outlook.claim: Reduction of GST rate from 28% to 18% is helping capture market share from the grey market and duplicators.
demand_outlook.quote: Since all our products were under the category of 28% GST, hence the reduction of GST rate from 28% to 18% is helping us to outgrow in the Indian aftermarket and capture more market share from grey market operators and duplicators.

capex_expansion.claim: The second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to set up a new plant in the South at Bangalore on a war footing.
capex_expansion.quote: We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex for the year may reach around Rs. 700 crore due to new orders.
capex_expansion.quote: We had given guidance about around Rs. 450 crore to Rs. 500 crore, but the way we are going and receiving the orders, as I today revised the guidance to high-teens, I think our capex may go to something like Rs. 700 crore this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to invest around Rs. 400 Cr in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

capex_expansion.claim: The 9.9 megawatt solar plant at Sirsa has been fully operational since April 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: I am happy to update that our 9.9 megawatt solar plant at Sirsa, Haryana has been fully operational since April 2025 and is delivering the sustainable operational economies on the expected lines.

margins_costs.claim: With aluminum prices expected to remain benign, management anticipates an improvement in EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: However, with aluminum prices expected to remain benign in the coming quarters, we anticipate an improvement in our EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: The payback of the investment in the captive solar plant is estimated to be in five and a half years.
margins_costs.quote: We can't quantify that number exactly, but we know very well that our payback of the investment is in five and a half years.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margins stood at 12.0% for Q1 FY27.
EBITDA margin was impacted by pass-through alloy prices, and would have been 80 basis points higher in Q4 FY26 without this impact.
margins_costs.quote: For this impact, EBITDA percentage would have been higher by 80 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Annual EBITDA margin for FY26 was 13.1% and would have been 40 basis points higher excluding the pass-through alloy price impact.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 551 Cr with 24.1% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin at 13.1%, however, EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices. For this impact, EBITDA percentage would have been higher by 40 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: A conscious loss of Rs. 5 Cr was incurred in March because aluminium price rises could not be immediately passed on in the aftermarket.
margins_costs.quote: There was a conscious loss by us of Rs. 5 Cr because every day we cannot increase the prices and the prices were rising actually every day.

margins_costs.claim: Aluminium price increases in April have been passed on to customers in both the aftermarket and OEM segments.
margins_costs.quote: Everything has been corrected April onwards and all these aluminium price rises which has happened in April also, they have been passed on to the customer both on the aftermarket front as well as to our OEM customers.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has confirmed alloy wheel orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore for the current financial year and about Rs. 250 crore for next financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: We have confirmed orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore depending on how the customer gear up for this financial year. However, for next financial year, we have confirmed orders of about Rs. 250 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Export supplies to Ford Motors are expected to be about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year and about Rs. 60 crore next year.
orders_capacity.quote: As regards your second question of Ford Motors, we will be doing exports of about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year, and next year, it is likely to go up to Rs. 60 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant has increased from 60%-65% in the previous quarter to about 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: happy to share that against the installed capacity in Karoli plant, from 60% to 65% that we were in the last quarter, we have now gone up to about 75%, and we are confident that in the last Q4, we will be around 80% of the capacity utilization

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Bangalore plant has reached 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: Very, very happy to share that Bangalore we have reached 90% capacity utilization that we set up last year, our 18th plant and the third plant in Bengaluru.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant is currently at 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the Karoli plant, the capacities utilization is still 65%, that is the reason that we have made investment for the alloy wheels.

capital_allocation.claim: Internal accruals will be utilized alongside external financing for cash flow management and capex funding.
capital_allocation.quote: We are actually keeping in mind our high mid-teen growth, our internal accruals will be sufficient; but yes, for cash flow management, we will have to take some external financing.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to take term loans for purchasing machines.
capital_allocation.quote: We will be taking term loan for machines.

capital_allocation.claim: Management is confident that the debt-to-equity ratio will remain under control and not exceed 0.5.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still very confident that our debt equity will remain under control and it will be not exceed 0.5.

capital_allocation.claim: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, amounting to Rs. 1.85 per equity share of Rs. 2 face value.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, that is Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.

capital_allocation.claim: Internal accruals and free cash will be ploughed back into the company while keeping debt levels within limits.
capital_allocation.quote: All these internal accruals free cash will be ploughed back in the company, so we will see to it even the debt levels are contained within the limits.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, causing a sharp increase in aluminum alloy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you are aware, after 28th February 2026, the geopolitical conflict in West Asia had created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, and had led to a sharp, phenomenal increase in aluminum alloy prices, which affected our industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages due to the denominator effect.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages due to the denominator effect.

risks_headwinds.claim: Debt levels increased due to sudden increase in working capital requirements resulting from commodity price hikes.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, it has increased, because due to sudden increase in working capital requirement due to commodity price increase, so there is an increase in debt.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia disrupted the global economy and caused undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency.
risks_headwinds.quote: After 28th February, 2026, geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, posing an unprecedented challenge in supply chain, creating undue volatility in energy, commodity and currency across the globe and it has started affecting Indian economy as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Revenue from exports declined to Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 due to trade disruptions, higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, and logistics costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our revenue from exports were at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 against Rs. 147 Cr last year because of the trade disruptions due to higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, logistic costs and other bottlenecks.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects its second captive solar plant in Bikaner to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to operationalize the new plant in Bangalore before March of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company anticipates seeing some profitability in the AISIN JV by the end of the year quarter.
management_commitments.quote: We are also expecting that by the end of this year quarter, we'll see some profitability there.

management_commitments.claim: Initial sunroof cable supplies will start from H2, with substantial growth expected next year.
management_commitments.quote: Initial supplies will start from H2, but next year, you will see substantial growth there.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to invest around Rs. 400 Cr in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to grow around mid-teens in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects alloy wheel revenue of around Rs. 90 to Rs. 100 Cr in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: FY27 we are expecting revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr and FY28 will be about Rs. 220 Cr.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
